title: FA/77/2014 of Satish Kumar AND ANOTHER Vs Collector special Land Acquisition Officer Haridawr AND OTHERS

paras.text:
FA No. 77 of 2014
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. Sandeep Kothari, Advocate
for the appellants.
Mr. I.P. Kohli, Standing Counsel
for the State.
Defect has not been removed
pertaining to the payment of court fee
despite of availing as much as more
than three years to deposit the same.
Learned counsel for the
appellants urges that the court fee has
not been provided by the appellants to
remove the defect.
So, in this eventuality, this
appeal is dismissed in non-prosecution.
